text:
alex: Quick design review for the evals regression diff view — small set of suggested changes.

maya: thanks! can you paste current screen or mockups?

alex: pasted two screenshots in thread (omitted). main things:
- diff rows feel dense; when a test has multiple evals the inline diff header repeats and makes scanning hard
- approval CTA 'Approve selected' sits next to delete; worried about accidental approvals +1 risk

jordan: agree on density. proposal: add a small chevron to collapse per-test diffs and show counts (passed/failed) at a glance.

sam: accessibility nit: the chevron needs aria-expanded and role button; keyboard focus visible.

maya: copy tweak for modal: current title 'Approve' -> suggest 'Approve test results' and microcopy: 'This will mark the selected test runs as approved for this baseline.' keeps it explicit.

alex: nice. also think we should add contextual hint lines beneath each diff: e.g., "Model changed 0.9s / token — content change: punctuation only" — helps reviewers prioritize.

jordan: how do we compute "content change" reliably? we could heuristic: levenshtein ratio + strip punctuation + threshold.

sam: from accessibility side, ensure hints are programmatically hidden from screen readers unless expanded; maybe use aria-hidden and a 'more details' toggle that is accessible.

maya: modal buttons: reorder to have 'Cancel' (left), 'Approve' (primary, right) and make 'Approve' require keyboard-confirm by Enter only when focused. also add confirmation toast with undo for 7s.

alex: UX question: should we allow bulk approve with a short confirm checkbox 'I reviewed changes' for orgs with strict audit flows? this could be an admin toggle in settings.

jordan: +1 — also add small audit metadata to the approval action: user, timestamp, model version. show in the scorecard history row.

sam: color contrast: green success pill on diff header currently 3.8:1. needs to be >=4.5 for normal text. suggest darker green or bold white text with stronger outline.

maya: mock copy suggestion for tooltip on diff severity: 'Severity indicates extent of content change vs baseline. Use severity to prioritize review.' short and clear.

alex: action items:
- [ ] design: update mock to include collapse chevrons, hint line, reordered modal (maya)
- [ ] eng: add aria attrs, keyboard behaviors, toast undo (sam + eng team)
- [ ] eng-ml: add heuristic signal and model-version metadata in logs (jordan)
- [ ] product: add admin toggle for 'require review confirmation' and update docs (alex)

maya: I'll ship updated Figma by EOD Friday. ping me if you want to pair on the modal copy.

sam: I'll run contrast checks and post exact color tokens.

jordan: I'll prototype the levenshtein check and share a small script.

alex: thanks all :thumbsup:

design-bot: New Figma link uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (preview) :sparkles:

maya: did we add keyboard shortcut for 'approve selected' (a)? risky but could be opt-in.

sam: if we add shortcut, ensure it's discoverable in the menu and can be disabled per-user.

alex: last thought — show tiny inline regression score delta (e.g., -3%) next to each test name so reviewers can triage without opening diffs.

maya: noted. will include in mocks.

jordan: OK closing this thread after we review the mock on Friday. last call for copy/qa.

alex: closing :checkered_flag:
